story_data.title: The Pajama Train
story_data.cover_prompt: A colorful illustration of a train with a smiling face, surrounded by marshmallows and fluffy clouds, pulling up to a bedroom window with a brave and excited girl in pajamas waving goodbye to her stuffed animal friends.

pages.text: Every night at 8:00 PM, an invisible train pulled up to the bedroom window of a little girl named Lily. She was a brave and curious girl with curly brown hair and bright green eyes. She loved wearing her favorite pair of striped pajamas with a big smile on her face.
pages.image_prompt: A warm and cozy illustration of Lily's bedroom, with a big window on the right side, showing a dark sky with stars and a big moon. Lily is standing in front of the window, wearing her striped pajamas, with a big smile on her face and her curly brown hair tied up in a ponytail. Her stuffed animal friends, a teddy bear and a rabbit, are sitting on the bed, watching her with big eyes.

pages.text: As the train pulled up, it became visible to Lily. It was a beautiful train with a shiny silver body and a big smile on its front. The train's wheels were made of fluffy marshmallows, and its whistle sounded like a gentle lullaby.
pages.image_prompt: A magical illustration of the Pajama Train pulling up to Lily's bedroom window. The train is visible, with its shiny silver body and big smile on its front. The marshmallow wheels are glowing softly, and the whistle is blowing a gentle stream of bubbles. Lily is standing in front of the window, looking amazed and delighted.

pages.text: The train's conductor, a friendly man with a kind face and a big hat, waved at Lily and invited her to come aboard. Lily eagerly climbed onto the train, feeling the soft marshmallow wheels beneath her feet.
pages.image_prompt: A warm illustration of Lily climbing onto the train, with the conductor helping her up. The conductor is wearing a big hat and a friendly smile, and Lily is looking excited and a bit nervous. The marshmallow wheels are squishing softly beneath her feet, and the train's interior is cozy and inviting.

pages.text: As the train chugged along the tracks, Lily saw that they were made of marshmallows too. The tracks stretched out into the distance, winding through a beautiful landscape of fluffy clouds and sparkling stars.
pages.image_prompt: A dreamy illustration of the train chugging along the marshmallow tracks, with Lily looking out the window in wonder. The tracks are stretching out into the distance, winding through a beautiful landscape of fluffy clouds and sparkling stars. The train's wheels are leaving behind a trail of squished marshmallows, and Lily's face is pressed against the window, taking it all in.

pages.text: The train pulled into a station called 'The Land of Nods,' where children from all over the world were waiting to board. They were all wearing their favorite pajamas, and they looked happy and sleepy.
pages.image_prompt: A lively illustration of the train pulling into the station, with children from all over the world waiting to board. The children are all wearing their favorite pajamas, and they look happy and sleepy. The station is decorated with colorful balloons and streamers, and the sign 'The Land of Nods' is written in big, bold letters.

pages.text: Lily met a boy named Max, who was wearing superhero pajamas. Together, they explored the Land of Nods, playing games and telling stories until it was time to go to sleep.
pages.image_prompt: A fun illustration of Lily and Max playing together in the Land of Nods. They are sitting on a big, fluffy cloud, playing a game of cards and laughing together. Max is wearing superhero pajamas, and Lily is still wearing her striped pajamas. The background is filled with colorful balloons and streamers, and the moon is shining brightly overhead.

pages.text: As the night came to an end, the Pajama Train pulled up to the station once again. Lily said goodbye to Max and climbed back onto the train, feeling happy and sleepy.
pages.image_prompt: A cozy illustration of Lily saying goodbye to Max and climbing back onto the train. The train is waiting at the station, with its marshmallow wheels glowing softly in the dark. Lily is waving goodbye to Max, and the conductor is smiling and waving goodbye too.

pages.text: The train pulled back into Lily's bedroom, and she climbed back into bed, feeling happy and content. She knew she would ride the Pajama Train again tomorrow night, and she couldn't wait.
pages.image_prompt: A warm illustration of Lily climbing back into bed, with the Pajama Train pulling away from the window. The bedroom is cozy and dark, with the moon shining brightly through the window. Lily is snuggled up in bed, smiling and looking happy, with her stuffed animal friends watching over her.
